name: Dedan
overview: Dedan is a male figure identified in Scripture as the son of Raamah, according to Genesis 10:7. There is no specific tribal affiliation or additional notes recorded about him in the biblical text. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical, situating him within the descendants of Noah's lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Dedan appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:7, with no explicit meaning provided in the text. It is not indicated that the name was given directly by God, nor is there an associated title or additional meaning noted.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Dedan as the son of Raamah, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Beyond this, no further family connections or relationships are mentioned in the biblical record.
scriptureSignificance: Dedan's significance lies in his place within the genealogical record of Genesis 10:7, which traces the descendants of Noah and the spreading of nations after the flood. As a son of Raamah, Dedan contributes to the biblical understanding of the origins of various peoples and their connections to the broader narrative of God's providential history. While not a central figure in major biblical events, his mention underscores the detailed nature of Scripture's genealogies.
